name: banked-reset-net
description: A cross-platform tray app for tracking and safely using Codex banked resets before they expire.
author: Banked Reset Safety Net contributors

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && electron-vite build
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm prepare:icons && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: pnpm prepare:icons && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm prepare:icons && pnpm build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:win:x64: pnpm prepare:icons && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64: pnpm prepare:icons && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --config.publish.channel=latest-arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: pnpm prepare:icons && pnpm build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --config.artifactName=Banked-Reset-Safety-Net-linux-x64.\${ext} --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: pnpm prepare:icons && pnpm build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --arm64 --config.artifactName=Banked-Reset-Safety-Net-linux-arm64.\${ext} --config.publish.channel=latest-arm64 --publish never

linux.synopsis: Track Codex usage windows and safely use banked resets before expiry
